bullets.text: Chelsea Stadium Gets Mobile Boost - **Virgin Media O2** enhances connectivity for fans at Stamford Bridge with upgraded mobile infrastructure.
6 GHz Spectrum Split Proposed - **Ofcom** plans to divide the 6 GHz band for mobile and Wi-Fi, enhancing wireless capacity.
Ericsson Job Cuts Announced - **Ericsson** to reduce 1,600 jobs in Sweden to improve competitiveness amid financial challenges.
AI Investment Surge Among Telcos - **KPMG** report shows 84% of telecom CEOs expect positive ROI from AI within three years.
NEC Exits 5G Base Station Market - **NEC** halts development of 4G/5G base stations, shifting focus to specialized applications.
Samsung's vRAN Success - **Samsung** demonstrates single-server vRAN viability, reducing hardware sprawl for telecom operators.
Starlink Expands Satellite Fleet - **SpaceX** receives FCC approval for 7,500 new Gen2 satellites to enhance broadband coverage.
AI-RAN Delivers ROI for Telcos - **AI-RAN** technology shows promise in improving energy efficiency and spectral gains for operators.
CypressTel Embraces AI - **CypressTel** integrates AI into SD-WAN and SASE solutions, enhancing network operations and security.
FirstNet Tests Satellite Connectivity - **AT&T's FirstNet** trials satellite service to enhance emergency communication coverage.
